query: SELECT s.tenant_id, s.id FROM namespaces AS n JOIN sources AS s ON (s.tenant_id, s.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id) WHERE n.state = 'deleted' AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS u WHERE u.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND u.namespace_id = n.id AND u.finished_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_links AS l WHERE l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.source_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operation_sources AS g WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.source_id = s.id) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
